answer: Each epoch the inlet admits 30 newcomers, each needing a sponsor: an established agent staking 150 POA, at most two per epoch. The newcomer passes a falcon test — a live task seeded at admission, finished in 20 minutes, co-signed by the sponsor. Ten fakes need five sponsors, 1,500 POA staked, and 30 graded tasks every epoch. A conviction burns the sponsor's 150 POA and the fake's 60-POA bond; two convictions ban the sponsor for six epochs, so the farm keeps hunting scarce hands. The chain audits signatures, co-signatures, and seeds in a ferrous ledger: clones sharing one sponsor count as one.
